description: This file implements the DeviceInfo class, providing methods to retrieve device-specific information such as serial number, SKU, manufacturer, model, device type, and distributor ID. It interacts with system files, external APIs, and configuration parameters to gather this data.

classes.name: DeviceInfoImplementation
classes.description: Class implementing device information retrieval functions, utilizing various data sources such as files and APIs.

methods.name: SerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the device's serial number by fetching MFR data or RFC parameter.

methods.name: Sku
methods.description: Retrieves the device's SKU/model name from a device properties file, MFR data, or RFC parameter.

methods.name: Make
methods.description: Retrieves the manufacturer of the device from MFR data or device properties file.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Retrieves the device model name, primarily from device properties file or provisioned model name if available.

methods.name: DeviceType
methods.description: Determines the device type from configuration files, with conditional logic for different build configurations.

methods.name: DistributorId
methods.description: Retrieves the distributor ID from a specific file or using RFC data.
